channel.title: Epic Games incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from Epic Games's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: Fortnite Login Issues on PlayStation 4 and PlayStation 5 [resolved]
item.description: Login services on PlayStation 4 and 5 have returned to normal.

item.title: Support-A-Creator Website Down [resolved]
item.description: The Support-A-Creator website has been restored.

item.title: Error When Installing or Updating on Epic Games Store [resolved]
item.description:
We've fixed an issue with the Epic Games Launcher where players were unable to update or install games, or where they saw it appear blank.
This fix is out now, and if your launcher still appears blank please follow these steps: https://epic.gm/LibraryMissing

item.title: Login failure to EOS Game Services with certain valid OpenId tokens. [resolved]
item.description: We pushed a change to our IDP service that blocked some valid OpenId tokens. We rolled the change back on 5/27/2026 6:00am

item.title: Stats Delayed [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved.

item.title: V-Bucks Delivery Delayed [resolved]
item.description:
Players who saw a delay in receiving V-Bucks should now have them available.
As part of this fix, players who qualify for the Showdown Umbrella styles introduced in today's update may see them granted at a later date.

item.title: Login and matchmaking issues in Fortnite [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved.

item.title: EAS Auth Access Token with additional claims [resolved]
item.description: We have rolled back a change to our backend that included additional claims in the EAS Auth Access token. This change could break the login flow in some games that allocated a fixed-size buffer to the access token.

item.title: Rocket League Matchmaking Outage [resolved]
item.description: Matchmaking issues have been resolved. Players should now be able to queue into matches normally.

item.title: Login and Matchmaking Errors [resolved]
item.description: Log-in and Matchmaking has recovered and we're no longer seeing any server delays. We'll continue to monitor these services and address any issues that arise.

item.title: Issues with Publishing Tools and Developer Portal [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved.

item.title: Fortnite Matchmaking Issues [resolved]
item.description:
✅ Matchmaking errors are fixed. Players can jump into a game again without issue.
We're monitoring game servers to make sure everything returns to normal.

item.title: Issue with Unreal Revision Control in UEFN [resolved]

item.title: Elevated Error Rates for URC Connections. [resolved]

item.title: Epic Online Services - Issues accessing EOS backend [resolved]
item.description: There was an issue affecting Epic Online Services from 8:10 am to 8:55 am EDT. The likely symptom players faced was failure to log in.
